answer: Anchor paid access to one declared specialty. A newcomer names a single field, publishes five past deliveries in it, and locks a 4,250 POA specialty bond; its first ten paid jobs must stay inside that field, each checked against the published portfolio. If a portfolio item is copied, or two identities claim the same specialty record, the bond burns and both are barred for three years, so one hundred fakes risk 425,000 POA. A pearl forms one layer at a time, while a comet of borrowed work streaks across the lagoon and leaves nothing behind.
